name: gow3-dev-guard
description: Two-layer deterministic guardrails for the gow3_pc fork: PreToolUse blocks dangerous operations before execution (fail-closed, cd-tracking, git staged/worktree inspection); the trusted-source Audit Gate (audit_gate.py, CLI+CI via workflow_run from the default branch) verifies the repository's real changes against a trusted reference — security surfaces (.github/workflows, zcode/) require maintainer approval records on the trusted ref, upstream exceptions are blob-proven (windows-v2.1.7 @ b907d8a9), self-integrity is class-based; Stop validates the GOW3 ZCODE FINAL REPORT; SessionStart injects context.
